propositions: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket signatures omit write parameters (force, reason, caused_by, ref) already supported by the library and CLI, causing FastMCP to drop undeclared payload keys.

The MCP adapter callable signatures and forwarding logic independently omit parameter forwarding to the core library functions, preventing these parameters from reaching the business logic even if declared in the schema.
MCP caused_by, ref, and force must be exposed as library-compatible parameters in the registered signatures and forwarded unchanged to rebar.transition and rebar.claim.

The 2026-08-18 operator ruling establishes total lib/CLI/MCP parity with force allowed through every surface and absent certification as the audit signal, rescinding the prior CLI/library-only force policy.
